title: 第19章 我们来玩个小游戏三百减七第20章 我这人向来守信诛
slug: 都市修仙五年下山就无敌
content_zh:
武者。
万中无一，地位超然。
超脱于律法，拥有常人难以想象的恐怖力量，修至巅峰甚至可以延寿两百载。
赵荣曾亲眼见过武道宗师出手。
一拳碎山。
一掌断河。
一念杀人。
种种神通已然称神！
赵家嫡子的赵荣做梦都想成为武者，赵家为此投入近十亿，可他没有练武的天赋。
赵家只能请来两位武者保护赵荣，虽说不是武宗，却也是难得一见的武道高手。
“这位朋友，同为武者，不如给我们夫妻一个薄面，今日之事就此揭过，如何？”
旗袍女子年纪约莫三十五六，长相一般，声音倒是娇媚动听。
“你也是武者！”
赵荣神色骤变，看向叶凡的目光是既震惊又嫉妒。
但下一秒，他脸上又浮现快意，纵是万中无一的武者又如何。
在东海市得罪了赵家，今天照样要死在这里！
“武者……”
叶凡已经不止一次听到‘武者’这个词，却是第一次见到武者。
目光扫视而去，目露异色。
有点意思。

虽是武者，可这一男一女体内竟有一缕无比杂乱的灵气运转。
纯度上不及叶凡所吐纳的灵气千分之一，算是超低配版的修行者。
想想也是。
在这灵气贫瘠的末法时代，求仙问道简直是难如登天，想要修行只能退而求其次。
可这一退。
一个修仙，一个修武。
一字之差，便是永远无法逾越的天堑。
……
瞧见叶凡没说话。
周芸和善道：“朋友，沿途尸体五脏六腑被震的粉碎，说明你尚不能完美控制劲气往一处打，浪费了太多劲气，想必是刚入四品吧？”
“而我夫妻二人皆是五品，你可要想仔细喽。”
武道共九品。
下三品练外劲，中三品练内劲，绝大部分武者终其一生卡在六品之下。
content_en:
Warrior.
One among ten thousand, his status is transcendent.
Beyond the law, he possesses terrifying power that is unimaginable to ordinary people. He can even extend his life by two hundred years if he reaches the peak of cultivation.
Zhao Rong had seen the martial arts master take action with his own eyes.
One punch breaks the mountain.
Cut off the river with one palm.
Killing with one thought.
All kinds of magical powers have become gods!
Zhao Rong, the legitimate son of the Zhao family, dreams of becoming a martial artist. The Zhao family has invested nearly one billion in this effort, but he has no talent for practicing martial arts.
The Zhao family could only invite two warriors to protect Zhao Rong. Although they were not martial arts masters, they were also rare martial arts masters.
"This friend, who is also a warrior, why don't you give me and your wife a good look and let the matter of today be revealed?"
The woman in the cheongsam is about thirty-five or sixty-six years old. She has an average appearance and a charming voice.
"You are also a warrior!"
Zhao Rong's expression suddenly changed, and he looked at Ye Fan with shock and jealousy.
But the next second, joy appeared on his face again, so what if he was a warrior who was unique among thousands.
If you offended the Zhao family in Donghai City, you will still die here today!
"Warrior..."
Ye Fan had heard the word 'warrior' more than once, but this was the first time he saw a warrior.
His eyes glanced away, revealing a strange color.
Interesting.
Although they are warriors, this man and woman actually have an extremely chaotic spiritual energy circulating within their bodies.
The purity is less than one thousandth of the spiritual energy exhaled by Ye Fan, and it can be regarded as a super low-end version of the practitioner.
Think about it too.
In this age of Dharma-ending with poor spiritual energy, seeking immortality and seeking enlightenment is simply as difficult as reaching heaven. If you want to practice cultivation, you can only settle for the next best thing.
But this retreat.
One cultivates immortality and the other cultivates martial arts.
The difference of one word is a chasm that can never be crossed.
…
Seeing that Ye Fan didn't speak.
Zhou Yun said kindly: "Friend, the internal organs of the corpse were shattered by the shock along the way, which means that you can't perfectly control your energy to hit one place, and you waste too much energy. You must have just entered the fourth level, right?"
"And my husband and I are both fifth grade, so you have to be careful."
There are nine levels of martial arts.
The lower third level is used to practice external strength, and the middle third level is used to practice internal strength. Most warriors are stuck below the sixth level throughout their lives.
